remediation.explanation: The pipeline log shows schema-validation failure due to missing order_id column. The source runbook defines order_identifier as the canonical field. The check_datetime_parse diagnostic reveals mixed datetime formats in created_at requiring explicit accepted_formats. Both faults require distinct remediation: rename column mapping and datetime format normalization. No records will be dropped; rename is a working-copy adaptation and datetime repair uses explicit format acceptance with reject-on-error policy.

created_at column parses entirely under rfc3339 format
no parse failures or rejected rows in created_at
remediation.title: Rename order_identifier to order_id and normalize created_at to RFC 3339 UTC

verification.reason: The pipeline log shows schema-validation failure due to missing order_id column, while the source runbook defines order_identifier as the canonical field. The log line explicitly records missing_required_column=order_id. The check_datetime_parse diagnostic reveals mixed datetime formats in created_at that require explicit accepted_formats to parse, with 2 parse failures under MM/DD/YYYY hh:mm AM UTC and 1 failure under rfc3339. The check_type_conformance diagnostic failed safely due to unknown column order_id, preventing direct type observation, but the log signature confirms the schema-validation stage aborted before type checks could run. The combined independently supported faults are: (1) schema_column_renamed - source uses order_identifier but validation expects order_id; (2) mixed_datetime_formats - created_at contains mixed formats preventing RFC 3339 UTC normalization without explicit format acceptance. These two cause codes each require distinct remediation: rename column mapping and datetime format normalization. No other fault meets the threshold of independent diagnostic support.
